tasks.short: Write model specifications and the data collection methods.

steps.what: List the data collection fields the model specifications need.

loop.input: Current model inputs and the questions still open
loop.output: Rows for field, source, frequency and owner
loop.check: The analyst checks each field against the model it feeds
loop.stop: One pass; a field with no owner stays blank
loop.why_not_simpler: Inputs are described in prose, so a fixed form misses names

steps.what: Confirm which series the collection methods can supply.
Write the model specifications and the data collection methods.
Draft the model specifications into the house template.

loop.input: Specification draft and the house template headings
loop.output: A specification with field, source, frequency and fallback
loop.check: The analyst deletes a heading the draft did not decide
loop.stop: Stop when every heading is filled or marked open
loop.why_not_simpler: The template mixes fixed headings with free-text method notes

tasks.design: Missing collection fields are listed from the current model, and the data owner confirms supply. The analyst writes the model specifications. {DOCS} places them in the house template, and only a checked version is issued.
tasks.previous_blocker: Specifications were rewritten from memory, so a field's owner and frequency were not stable.
tasks.enabler_now: A template can hold fields once they are named. Deciding the method, and what to do when a series is not supplied, cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A model that needs a series nobody can supply.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst knows which missing series blocks the model and which has a fallback.
tasks.altitude: Drafts start from the template. The analyst still writes the method and can hold an issue. Decision rights on the specification do not move.

reach.task: Say which borrower fields a credit model is allowed to collect
reach.learn: Which collection fields a lending neighbour will not provide

evidence.claim: Writing a model specification stays with the analyst who will be accountable for the method.
Placing named fields into a fixed template is a drafting task once the decisions exist.

assumptions: Focal role is the quantitative analyst. The data owner's confirmation is not the analyst's saving. Boundary: from open questions to an issued specification. Building the model is later.

Structured fields are field name, source, frequency, owner and fallback. The analyst writes the method; the data owner confirms supply. Fallback: a field with no owner is marked open and is not issued as decided.
Configure the house template in {DOCS} before custom code.
Upkeep of 5 hours per 100 baseline hours covers a new heading on the template.
unknowns: Whether data owners already name series the model uses.
Whether the house template headings are agreed.
research_questions: What share of fields have an owner before the draft?
How often is an issue held because supply was not confirmed?

incremental.description: Add a template heading when a new method type is used

approvals.approved_version: model specification the analyst checked against the supply confirmation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: owners and headings are unclear, so the list and the template are done by hand and the method is unchanged. High: fields are known and only the template draft shrinks. Writing the method stays. The data owner's time is not saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Draft a financial research summary and sign the version that ties.

steps.what: Pull the figures for the written financial research summary.
Draft the written summary reports of the financial research results.

loop.input: Research figures and the question the summary must answer
loop.output: A summary in which every figure carries a source tag
loop.check: The analyst deletes a sentence whose figure has no tag
loop.stop: One pass; an untagged sentence is removed, not guessed
loop.why_not_simpler: The question is prose, so a fixed report cannot write the argument

steps.what: Cut any research sentence that has no source tag.
Sign and send the financial research summary.

tasks.design: {BI} pulls the research figures. A draft summary may use only those figures, each with a source tag, and the analyst deletes the rest. The analyst signs and sends the summary; an untagged sentence is not sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: Notes were written from memory of the book, so a figure could not be traced after the note went out.
tasks.enabler_now: Figures can be pulled, and a draft can be limited to tagged numbers. Deciding what the result means, and signing the note, cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A research question the pulled figures do not answer.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst knows which sentence is supported and which only sounds plausible.

ambition.what: A summary is written when a position changes, not only for the monthly pack.

tasks.altitude: Figures are ready before writing. The analyst still cuts unsupported sentences and can refuse to send. Decision rights on the note do not move.

reach.task: Say which research sentences may be repeated to a client
reach.learn: Which summary lines are safe outside the desk

evidence.claim: In a published spreadsheet-agent test, most models ended a cash waterfall at €1.16 million, not €580,000.
A research summary that is not tied to source figures can state numbers the book does not contain.

assumptions: Focal role is the quantitative analyst. Boundary: from a research question to a sent summary. The reader's decision is outside this task.
Structured fields are figure, source tag, as-of date and sentence id. The book produces the figure. Fallback: a sentence with no source tag is deleted and is not sent.
Configure the figure pull on {BI} before custom code.
Upkeep of 5 hours per 100 baseline hours covers a new figure added to the pull.
unknowns: Whether research figures already carry a stable source tag.
Who the summary is allowed to be sent to.
research_questions: What share of draft sentences arrive without a source tag?
How often is a summary held because a figure does not tie?

incremental.description: Add a figure to the research pull

approvals.approved_version: summary the analyst checked against tagged research figures

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the question is nonstandard, so the pull does not cover it and the summary is written by hand. High: figures are tagged and only the draft shrinks. Signing stays. A note that the figures do not answer stays manual.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Modify a financial analytic model and accept it on its tests.

steps.what: List every financial analytic model and its stored test.
Compare the requested change with the model's stored test.
Modify the financial analytic model and rerun its tests.
Note which analytic test still fails after the change.

loop.input: Test results after the model change
loop.output: A note listing each failed test and the input that failed
loop.check: The analyst checks a failed test against the result log
loop.stop: Stop when every failed test is listed or the log is empty
loop.why_not_simpler: Failure text is free form, so a fixed status flag hides the cause

steps.what: Accept the modified financial model on a passing test.

tasks.design: The inventory and the stored tests are listed, and the requested change is compared with those tests. The analyst still modifies the financial model. Acceptance is allowed only when the tests the analyst relies on have passed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Models were edited in place, so the test that used to pass was not rerun.
tasks.enabler_now: An inventory and a stored test can be rerun once they exist. Changing the model, and judging a test that still fails, cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A change whose effect the stored tests do not cover.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst knows when a passing test is too narrow for the change.
tasks.altitude: Edits still take the week. Tests are rerun before acceptance. The analyst can refuse a change whose test fails. Decision rights on the model do not move.

reach.task: Say which model changes must be disclosed
reach.learn: Which modifications a disclosure has to mention

evidence.claim: Changing a financial model stays with the analyst; a stored test only shows what it was built to show.
In a published spreadsheet-agent test, most models ended a cash waterfall at €1.16 million, not €580,000.

assumptions: Focal role is the quantitative analyst. Boundary: from a change request to an acceptance. Inventing a new model is a different task.

Structured fields are model id, test id, expected value and change note. The inventory produces the model id; the analyst writes the change. Fallback: a model with no stored test is not accepted on this path.
Configure the inventory on {DATA_PLATFORM} before custom code.
Upkeep of 8 hours per 100 baseline hours covers a new test stored for a model.
unknowns: Whether every model in use has a stored test.
Whether a failed test blocks use or only blocks acceptance.
research_questions: What share of models have a stored test today?
How often does a change pass the stored tests and still get refused?

incremental.description: Store a new test when a model type changes

approvals.approved_version: acceptance of the modified model on the tests the analyst checked

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the model has no stored test, so the comparison is manual and the edit is unchanged. High: tests exist and only the inventory and the rerun shrink. The modification stays.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Hear the traders' question and send a checked valuation figure.

steps.what: Hear the traders' question on valuations or data.
Pull the series the traders' question names.
Give analytical support and the limit of that figure.
Send the checked figure as analytical support.

tasks.design: The analyst hears the traders' question, and {DATA_PLATFORM} pulls the named series. The answer, including the limit of the figure, stays with the analyst. A figure is sent only after that check, because a trader may use it.
tasks.previous_blocker: The series was hunted during the conversation, so the answer waited on a search.
tasks.enabler_now: A named series can be pulled before the reply. Hearing the question, and stating the limit of the figure, cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A question whose series does not exist, or whose valuation is not a lookup.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst knows when a number will be used as a price and when it is only a clue.
tasks.altitude: The series is ready during the conversation. The analyst still hears the question and can refuse to send a figure. Decision rights on the answer do not move.

reach.task: Say how a valuation figure is explained without overstating it
reach.learn: Which limits must be said with a figure

evidence.claim: Answering a trader about a valuation stays with the analyst who will be asked the next question.
Pulling a named series is a query once the question names the instrument and the date.

assumptions: Focal role is the quantitative analyst. The trader's own use of the figure is not the analyst's saving. Boundary: from a question to a sent figure. Building a new tool is a later task.
Structured fields are instrument, date, value and limit. The question names the instrument; the series produces the value. Fallback: a question that names no instrument is not answered from the pull.
Configure the series pull on {DATA_PLATFORM} before custom code.
Upkeep of 3 hours per 100 baseline hours covers a new instrument on the pull.
unknowns: Whether traders name instruments in a way the series can match.
Whether a sent figure is treated as a price.
research_questions: What share of questions name an instrument that can be pulled?
How often is a figure not sent because the limit is unclear?

incremental.description: Add an instrument to the support pull

approvals.approved_version: figure and limit the analyst checked for this traders' question

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the question is not a lookup, so nothing is pulled and the conversation is unchanged. High: the series is named and only the pull shrinks. Hearing the question and stating the limit stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week is still writing methods, signing research notes and answering traders. Figures, inventories and named series are ready beforehand. The analyst can hold a specification, a note or a figure that does not tie.
reach: Loan officers: say which borrower fields a credit model may collect
Personal financial advisors: say which research sentences may be repeated to a client
Regulatory affairs specialists: say which model changes must be disclosed
skills_to_grow: Writing a collection method that names an owner and a fallback
Deleting a research sentence that has no source tag
Stating the limit of a figure before it is sent
role.ambitious_version: Every issued specification names its sources, every sent summary uses only tagged figures, and a model change is accepted only on a test the analyst has stored.
